Package org.hivevisionftc.vision

Class VisionConfig

java.lang.Object
org.hivevisionftc.vision.VisionConfig
public final class VisionConfig extends Object
Camera mounting geometry and detection thresholds. Every setter returns this, so calls can be chained.

Distances are inches and angles are degrees. The robot frame has +X forward and +Y to the left. See the calibration guide for how to measure each value.

    • targetHeightIn

      public VisionConfig targetHeightIn(double targetHeightIn)
      Height of the center of the game element above the floor. The camera must be above this.

    • maxStalenessMs

      public VisionConfig maxStalenessMs(long maxStalenessMs)
      Detections older than this are discarded.

    • minConfidence

      public VisionConfig minConfidence(double minConfidence)
      Detections below this confidence (0 to 1) are discarded.

      The Limelight also applies its own threshold in the web UI. If that one is higher, the camera never reports the detection and this value cannot bring it back.
